text:
maria: heads up — saw a mini-burst in streaming tail latency around 10:42 UTC. p99 token latency jumped ~2.5x for ~30s, only on the streaming path, not plain generate. logs attached below.
ajay: ugh. any obvious kernel changes rolled recently? batch shape differences? :thinking_face:
maria: no deploys at the time (checked deploy-bot). deploy-bot: no deploys in the window. it looks correlated with a short spike in kv-evict-rate and a change in kernel selection on a subset of nodes.
perf-bot: automated profile uploaded -> https://perf.internal/trace/2056007890 (flamegraph + syscall timeline)
maria: quick dump of metrics during the incident:
```
redwood_token_latency_ms{route="/v1/stream",quantile="0.5"} = 12
redwood_token_latency_ms{route="/v1/stream",quantile="0.95"} = 38
redwood_token_latency_ms{route="/v1/stream",quantile="0.99"} = 120  # spike
redwood_stream_emit_interval_ms_bucket{le="20"} increased -> fewer emits in <20ms
kv_evictions_per_sec = 12
kernel_selector_choice{node="node-42"} = "attn_fused_v2_fp16"
```
ajay: kernel_selector choosing attn_fused_v2_fp16 is interesting — that kernel has been flakier when seq_len distribution is wide. can you paste the batch size / seq_len histogram?
maria: seq_len histogram (sampled): 1-64: 32%, 65-256: 48%, 257-1024: 20%. batch sizes avg 6, tail up to 12. batching.min_batch was 4, heuristic_v1.
tess: reminds me of the old oscillation bug where heuristic_v1 toggles kernels mid-request when hot KV cache causes slight timing differences. does trace show kernel switch mid-stream?
maria: yes — perf trace shows a kernel switch between token 15 and 16 for the same request on node-42. timeline: server emitted chunk at t=0ms (kernel A), then client observed a 140ms gap, server resumed with kernel B. kv-lookups had small latency spike just before switch.
sre_ops: kv-evict-rate=12/s could cause cache churn; if KV misses lead to heavier memcopy or fallback path that affects kernel selection heuristics, we could hit tail. do we have per-kernel latency histograms?
maria: attaching sampled numbers:
```
kernel: attn_fused_v1_fp16 p50=8ms p95=22ms p99=55ms
kernel: attn_fused_v2_fp16 p50=9ms p95=30ms p99=140ms
```
ajay: that p99 for v2 is the culprit. heuristic_v1 chooses v2 when avg seq_len > 200 in the window; but for mixed workloads that can be wrong. propose rolling back selector to deterministic per-route config for streaming routes.
tess: also think caching behavior matters — when KV misses spike, memory bandwidth hit increases and v2 degrades worse than v1. short-term mitigation: force attn_fused_v1_fp16 on streaming routes and bump batching.min_batch to 8 to reduce oscillation.
maria: how risky is forcing kernel? will it regress latency on long sequences?
ajay: small regression for long sequences p50 (~+1ms) but reduces tail by >50ms. safer than oscillation.
sre_ops: will update autoscale policy to drain node-42 and repro locally. also adding a Grafana panel for per-node kernel_choice and kv_eviction_rate.
perf-bot: added alerts: (1) redwood_stream_emit_interval_ms_p99 > 100ms for 15s, (2) kernel_switch_count_per_request > 0.1% in 1m
maria: for instrumentation/dashboard work — suggested panels/queries to add:
- Per-route token-level latency heatmap: sum by(route,quantile) redwood_token_latency_ms
- Kernel choice over time: kernel_selector_choice{route=~"/v1/.*"}
- Per-request kernel_switch count: increase tracing sampling for streaming routes
- Client vs server timing breakdown: add redwood_stream_client_ack_ms and redwood_stream_server_emit_ms and a derived latency gap panel
- KV hotpath: kv_lookup_latency_ms and kv_evictions_per_sec by node
ajay: sample PromQL for emit gap: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_stream_emit_interval_ms_bucket[1m])) by (le, route))
tess: I'll add a small dashboard card showing token-level waterfall for sampled traces so product folks can correlate quality regressions.
maria: immediate action plan:
1) Rollback kernel_selector to deterministic v1 for streaming routes (safe rollback) — @deploy-bot can we patch config on the fleet?
2) Bump batching.min_batch to 8 on streaming prod pool (staged) — Ajay/Tess to coordinate
3) Add Grafana panels + perf-bot alerts (SRE)
4) Re-run captured trace on local nodes with kv-evict simulation to reproduce
SRE_ops: ack. I'll cordon node-42 and create a canary for the v1-only kernel. will loop back in 30m.
deploy-bot: configuration change queued: change_set=kernel_selector.stream_routes=heuristic_v1->deterministic_v1, target=prod-streaming-pool, change_id=chg-2056007890
maria: thanks. leaving traces and logs in the incident folder. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if this confirms the heuristic bug. :white_check_mark:
ajay: nice triage. if we confirm, we should add a kernel-selection fuzz test to the perf CI to catch oscillation with KV-churn patterns.
maria: +1. thanks everyone.
